text: Power point by the kitchen is sparking and the wall around it feels hot. I’ve switched off that circuit and need someone to make it safe today.
The power keeps cutting out and we’ve got no lights in part of the house. There are eight of us staying here, and the wet road can close, so please let us know when a crew can get through.
Since yesterday, the light in the back bedroom has stopped working. There are eleven of us in the three-bedroom house, including my elderly mother and the baby, but the rest of the power is fine.

A pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water is running across the floor. My daughter turned off the water at the meter, but it needs fixing before it damages more of the house. I am an older woman and have lived here a long time.
We have no hot water since this morning. There are seven of us across three generations, so washing is hard; the cold taps still work.
Tenant says the bathroom tap has been dripping for several days. She reports the water is still running normally and asks for the tap to be repaired.
Sewage is coming up through the bathroom drain and onto the floor. The house gets very hot by afternoon, and our two kids are here; this needs making safe now.
The toilet is blocked and will not flush, but nothing is coming up through the drain. I work nights, so please arrange a time when I can be home.

The outside drain has been slow since yesterday, but the toilets and sinks still work. My adult son lives with us and needs daily care from me and my partner. Could someone check the drain when available?
Part of the roof has come loose in the wind and is lifting up. We are expecting our first baby next month, and I’m worried it could come down; the road is sealed, but the crew is a long way away.
Tenant says the air conditioner has stopped cooling the house. He is an older man with limited mobility and lives alone; the room is getting very hot in the afternoon.
Tenant says the air conditioner makes a rattling noise when it runs, but it still cools the house. She reports that she, her partner and their child are at home and would like it checked.
The front door lock has come away and we can't secure the house. We've got a newborn here.
The hot water stopped working yesterday. We have no hot water at all now. We're both in our eighties and need it for washing. We know supplies and crews have to come by barge or plane.
The hot water has been patchy since last week, but it still comes through. My elderly parent lives with me, and we'd appreciate someone checking the unit when available.
The stove has started smoking and a flame came out near the knob. We turned it off at the switch. With this tin roof and no shade, the heat is bad already, and there's three kids here.
Tenant says a section of the roof is sagging after recent rain, though it is not leaking inside. She reports six people live there, including an adult with kidney disease.
Tenant reports a loose roof sheet rattles in the wind. No water is coming in at present.
Power point is sparking when used. Switched it off at the wall; one adult here is on dialysis three days a week.

The front door deadlock won't turn since Monday, but the latch still closes and the house can be locked. I'm seven months pregnant and we have a toddler here. The road can close in the wet, so please let us know when someone can come.
The screen door latch is loose but the main door still locks. There's seven of us in the house, including our baby under one, so it's crowded and we need the latch fixed.
A pipe has burst under the sink and water is flooding the kitchen. We turned off the main tap, but there's water all over the floor. My partner has diabetes and we've got a two-year-old here.
Tenant says the stove has stopped working and they cannot cook at home. She reports they are both retired, in their sixties, and the west-facing house only has fans in the heat.
One burner won't light, but the other one works. Could someone check the stove when a crew is next out this way?
Sewage is coming up through the bathroom drain and spreading across the floor. My partner is pregnant and we can't use that room safely.

Since yesterday, ants have been getting into the pantry and food containers. My husband has severe asthma, and the insects are making it hard to keep the kitchen clean. The wet season road can close, so please arrange pest treatment.
There are cockroaches in the kitchen cupboards and under the sink. We are nine in the house, with two little ones under five, so the food area gets busy. Please treat them when you can.

Part of the roof has come loose in the rain and is hanging down over the bedroom. We can see daylight through the opening and water is getting in, so we have moved away from that room. The road can close in wet season, but this needs someone to make it safe.
Tenant says the hot water has stopped working since this morning. She is pregnant and cannot get warm water for washing; her mother and siblings are in the house too.
The kitchen cupboard door has come off its hinge and won't shut. I'm raising two grandchildren, the youngest is four, and it is getting in the way.

The front door lock broke last night and the door will not lock now. We have three children under ten, including an eighteen-month-old, and can't secure the house. Please send someone to make it safe.

The power has gone off in half the house since yesterday afternoon. Four adults live here and we all work, so we need the lights and power back. There is no smoke or exposed wiring, and the sealed road is open for the crew.
The light in my bedroom keeps flickering when I turn it on. Nothing smells burnt and the rest of the power is working. I've been here a few years and reckon the switch needs a look.

Tenant says the stove has a strong gas smell and the burner will not turn off. She has newborn twins and a four-year-old, so they have moved outside while awaiting urgent help; access is by barge or plane.
Tenant reports there is no hot water at the taps. She and her elderly husband are caring for three grandchildren under six, and washing them is difficult without it.
The laundry tap drips into the tub and the handle is stiff. I live by myself and can still use the other taps.
